For a first-timer, the safest and easiest way to get started is to keep things simple and focus on good form. If you’re using kettlebells, start with a lighter weight—around 18–26 lb (8–12 kg)—and always choose the lighter option if you’re unsure. For basic movements like swings or squats, make sure you can complete each set with control. Walking is also a great entry point: try a 5-minute easy walk, then alternate 3 minutes brisk and 3 minutes easy, repeating this several times. If you’re interested in HYROX or hybrid fitness, begin with comfortable distances or paces, like a 20-minute jog or fast walk a couple of times a week, and build up gradually. Focus on technique and control, and increase intensity over time.
